description: You had outpatient surgery and received confusing medical bills. Create a reconciliation spreadsheet to dispute billing errors. Open /home/ga/Documents/medical_billing_dispute.xlsx and organize it into three sections: (1) Provider Charges showing what was billed vs. insurance-allowed amounts, (2) Payment Breakdown showing what's already been paid, (3) Reconciliation calculating what you actually owe vs. what the hospital claims. Reference documents are in /home/ga/Documents/Medical_Bills/. Format key amounts in bold and highlight the discrepancy in red. Save with Ctrl+S.
